notes:
Snapshot from AE/SE calls and security review. Short bullets — useful for next steps.

Context: PillarBridge is a regional health system integrator powering chart search and clinician-facing retrieval across 10 hospital systems. Looking to replace bespoke Lucene-based index + in-house BM25 pipeline with a RAG stack: dense embeddings + lightweight reranker for result precision. Primary driver: clinical search accuracy and strict PHI controls.

Scale & Performance requirements: ~45M clinical documents (notes, imaging reports, discharge summaries) for initial index; projected growth to 120M in 18 months. Peak QPS expected 300 qps for search microservice (spiky mornings). SLA target: p95 latency <= 250ms for top-5 results, p99 <= 500ms. Cost target: <$0.03 per query at 90th percentile after batching/caching optimizations.

Security & Compliance: absolutely no PHI egress to public endpoints. Must support VPC-only private control plane or on-prem deployment. Mandatory: SSO (SAML + SCIM), KMS integration (customer-managed keys), immutable audit logs retained for 7+ years, fine-grained RBAC, and support for e-discovery requests. Team repeated: "If anything leaves our VPC, legal wont sign off."

Model & architecture preferences: prefer open checkpoint models for auditability; interested in quantized variants for cost. Want vector store with hybrid reranking (embedding similarity -> lightweight transformer reranker) instead of heavy cross-encoders on full result set. Ask: can Redwood provide precomputed embeddings pipeline + incremental reindexing hooks? SE noted Redwood Optimize could recommend quantization / batching profiles.

POC plan (high level):
- Scope: 2-week technical POC, ingest 10M docs (de-identified subset + controlled PHI test samples).
- Goals: validate embedding throughput, end-to-end p95/p99, reranker precision lift (NDCG/Recall), cost-per-query model at expected QPS.
- Success criteria: p99 < 500ms on Dedicated private cluster; reranker improves top-5 relevancy by >12% vs BM25 baseline; no logs transmitted outside customer VPC.
- Deliverables: benchmark report, configuration profile (batching, cache TTLs), security attestation.

- 2026-01-28: Intro call (AE, SE): discussed architecture and PHI constraints.
- 2026-02-04: Security kickoff (red-team) — shared Security FAQ (drive). Redwood asked for KMS & audit log flow diagrams.
